title: Helping the Environment
description: Four recordings about a school club, a beach clean-up, recycling and a water week.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · The Green Club
parts.intro: You will hear Nam and Linh talking about a club meeting.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hi, Nam! Are you coming to the Green Club meeting after school?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, I am. Is it in the library again?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: No, it's in Room twelve today, because the library is closed. We start at four o'clock... no, sorry, a quarter past four.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Good. What are we going to do?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: We're going to make posters about plastic bags. Our teacher says we should bring old newspapers and some glue.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I haven't got any glue, but I can bring paper and my paints.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Great. I'll bring the glue. Oh, and don't forget your own water bottle. We don't use plastic cups at the club.

parts.title: Part 2 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Mr Brown, leaving a message about a beach clean-up.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Hello, everyone. This is Mr Brown with news about our beach clean-up. It's on Saturday, the eleventh of May, not Sunday as I said before.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: We meet at the bus stop outside school at eight o'clock. The bus takes forty minutes.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Please wear old clothes and strong shoes, and bring gloves if you have them. I will give you bags for the rubbish.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: We will also have lunch there, but it isn't free, so bring some money for a sandwich.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: If it rains, we will do the clean-up next week instead. Please call me if you cannot come. Thank you!

parts.title: Part 3 · Recycling at home
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and Tom talking about helping the environment.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Tom, why are you putting that bottle in the blue box?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: It's for recycling. At home, we have three boxes: blue for plastic, yellow for paper and green for glass.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My family only has one bin. I think it's time to change that.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: You can start with food, too. We put old vegetables in a garden box, and it makes good soil for our flowers.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: That's clever! Do you walk to school?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yes, I do. My brother rides his bike, and Dad takes the bus to work. We only use the car at the weekend.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I always come by car. Maybe I should walk with you tomorrow.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Sure! I leave home at half past seven.

parts.title: Part 4 · Save Water Week
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Ms Green, talking about Save Water Week at school.

script.speaker: Ms Green
script.text: Welcome to Save Water Week at our school. Let me tell you what we will do.

script.speaker: Ms Green
script.text: On Monday, each class will check the taps. If a tap drips, it can waste a whole bucket of water in a day.

script.speaker: Ms Green
script.text: On Tuesday, we will learn to take shorter showers. Five minutes is enough.

script.speaker: Ms Green
script.text: On Wednesday, we will collect rain in big buckets and use it for the school garden.

script.speaker: Ms Green
script.text: The best class will win a prize on Friday. The prize is a tree, which the winners can plant in the playground. Remember: every drop counts!
